What are these thoughts running through my head? Some weird memories, places I don’t recognize…
I have to smoke a fish joint right now. 
It’s not because I yearn for it. It’s because I don’t feel whole without it. 
A piece of me is missing right now. It all started with that dream and kept getting worse…
I shouldn’t have ignored it, but now it’s too late for that. I need to go forward…
